# Core specs

Real OpenAPI documents the stateful mock is tested against: small and medium APIs, hand-written and generated by
frameworks. `tests/core-specs.test.js` runs the classifier (`src/stateful/classify.js`) on each and compares the
result with a baseline.

The baseline counts each spec's operations by label:

- **Confident**: mapped to a stored record with nothing assumed.
- **Needs review**: mapped, but the classifier assumed something.
- **Plain mock**: no state; the mock answers with generated data.

They are third-party files, stored as downloaded on 2026-11-18 and not edited. They are test data only: the
package publishes `src/` alone, so none of them ships to npm. Each keeps its source's license.

| File | API | Kind | Source | License |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `museum.yaml` | Redocly Museum API | Hand-written | `Redocly/museum-openapi-example`, `main`, `openapi.yaml` | MIT |
| `realworld.yaml` | RealWorld (Conduit) | Hand-written | `gothinkster/realworld`, `main`, `specs/api/openapi.yml` | MIT (stated in the spec) |
| `eshop-catalog.json` | eShop Catalog API | Generated by ASP.NET Core | `dotnet/eShop`, `main`, `src/Catalog.API/Catalog.API.json` | MIT |
| `petclinic.yaml` | Spring PetClinic REST | Spring project | `spring-petclinic/spring-petclinic-rest`, `master`, `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` | Apache-2.0 |
| `pokeapi.yaml` | PokeAPI | Generated by Django REST (drf-spectacular), read-only | `PokeAPI/pokeapi`, `master`, `openapi.yml` | BSD-3-Clause |
| `calcom-v2.json` | Cal.com API v2 | Generated by NestJS | `calcom/cal.com`, `main`, `docs/api-reference/v2/openapi.json` | MIT (the repository's license) |
| `ably-control.json` | Ably Control API 1.0.14 | Vendor API | `api.apis.guru/v2/specs/ably.net/control/1.0.14/openapi.json` | None stated in the spec; the APIs.guru directory is CC0-1.0 |
| `mealie.json` | Mealie | Generated by FastAPI | `demo.mealie.io/openapi.json` (the project's demo server) | The project (`mealie-recipes/mealie`) is AGPL-3.0 |
| `immich.json` | Immich | Generated by NestJS | `immich-app/immich`, `main`, `open-api/immich-openapi-specs.json` | AGPL-3.0 |
| `nylas.json` | Nylas v3 | Vendor API | `developer.nylas.com/openapi.json` | None stated |
| `apicurio-registry.json` | Apicurio Registry API v2, 2.4.x | Open-source project API, nested paths | `api.apis.guru/v2/specs/apicurio.local/registry/2.4.x/openapi.json` | Apache 2.0 (stated in the spec) |
| `apideck-crm.json` | Apideck CRM API 9.3.0 | Vendor API, one envelope and id schema shared by every resource | `api.apis.guru/v2/specs/apideck.com/crm/9.3.0/openapi.json` | Apache 2.0 (stated in the spec) |

## Licenses to keep in mind

`mealie.json` and `immich.json` come from AGPL-3.0 projects, and `nylas.json` and `ably-control.json` state no
license. They are here as unmodified test inputs, apart from the package's MIT-licensed code, and must stay out of
anything published: do not add this folder to the package's `files`, and do not copy from these specs into `src/`
or the docs.

## Not included

The Train Travel API (Bump.sh) was tried and left out: it is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial, share-alike), and it
references a Markdown file the loader cannot find.

The Jira Cloud API (487 operations) was tried and left out as too large for this set, like Stripe. The Apideck HRIS
API was left out because it follows the same conventions as the Apideck CRM API here. The Swagger Petstore 3.0 was
left out because `tests/classify.test.js` already checks the Petstore in full, from `docs/public/specs/petstore-3.2.yaml`.

## Updating

Replace a file with a newer download, run `npm test`, and update the baseline in `tests/core-specs.test.js`
together with this table's date when the numbers change on purpose.
